name: Hunan Heshun Petroleum Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hunan Heshun Petroleum Co.,Ltd. engages in the wholesale and retail of gasoline and diesel in China. It is also involved in the gas station and convenience store operation, refined oil storage, refined oil logistics and distribution activities, charging station charging, warehousing leasing, and logistics and transportation services, as well as investment and construction of gas stations and oil depots. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Changsha, China.
